اعتضتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَضْتُنَّ (iʕtaḍtunna) /iʕ.tadˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# اُعْتِضْتُنَّ (uʕtiḍtunna) /uʕ.tidˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
